name: elasticsearch
label: ElasticSearch
description: ElasticSearch is a distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine capable of solving a number of use cases. This connector facilitates automated operations to execute lucene query, get mapping and cluster details.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.tooltip: The FQDN or IP address of the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect.

fields.title: Protocol
fields.name: protocol
fields.tooltip: The Protocol used to connect to the ElasticSearch server remotely. Choose between http or https. By default, https is used.

Basic Authentication.title: Username
Basic Authentication.name: username
Basic Authentication.tooltip: The Username to access the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect.
Basic Authentication.description: The Username to access the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

Basic Authentication.title: Password
Basic Authentication.name: password
Basic Authentication.tooltip: The Password to access the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect.
Basic Authentication.description: The Password to access the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

API Key Authentication.title: API Key
API Key Authentication.name: api_key
API Key Authentication.description: API Key to access the ElasticSearch server to which you will connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Port
fields.name: port
fields.tooltip: The Port number that is used to connect to the elasticsearch server. The default value is set to 9200.

fields.title: Maximum Retries
fields.name: max_retries
fields.tooltip: Set the maximum retries and connection timeout default value is set to 30 seconds.

operations.title: Get Cluster Details
operations.description: Retrieves cluster details and the health information about the cluster configured on your ElasticSearch instance, based on the index you have specified.

parameters.title: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.tooltip: An index is a logical namespace that maps to one or more primary shards and can have zero or more replica shards. Specify a particular index whose cluster details you want to retrieve from ElasticSearch.

parameters.title: Run As User
parameters.name: run_as_user
parameters.tooltip: Run as user is kind of a delegation of account access to a different account or an admin account. For example, User X take on the role of User Y with the help of run as user mechanism

operations.title: Get Mapping
operations.description: Retrieves a list of indices, which includes the type of indices that are currently configured on your ElasticSearch instance.

parameters.title: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.tooltip: An index is a logical namespace that maps to one or more primary shards and can have zero or more replica shards. You can specify a particular index or if you search for all indices, which are currently configured on your ElasticSearch instance, use _all.

parameters.title: Type
parameters.name: doc_type
parameters.tooltip: Type in ElasticSearch represents a class of similar documents. Specify the type of indices for which you want to retrieve details.

parameters.title: Run As User
parameters.name: run_as_user
parameters.tooltip: Run as user is kind of a delegation of account access to a different account or an admin account. For example, User X take on the role of User Y with the help of run as user mechanism

operations.title: Execute Query
operations.description: Executes a query and fetches data from your ElasticSearch instance, based on the input filters.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify a stringified JSON formatted query used for searching data in ElasticSearch

parameters.title: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.tooltip: An index is a logical namespace that maps to one or more primary shards and can have zero or more replica shards. Specify a particular index, based on which you want to run the query.

parameters.title: Type
parameters.name: doc_type
parameters.tooltip: Type in ElasticSearch represents a class of similar documents. Specify the type of indices, based on which you want to run the query.

parameters.title: Routing
parameters.name: routing
parameters.tooltip: Name of the shard for which you want to retrieve data.

parameters.title: Run As User
parameters.name: run_as_user
parameters.tooltip: Run as user is kind of a delegation of account access to a different account or an admin account. For example, User X take on the role of User Y with the help of run as user mechanism

parameters.title: Size
parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: Set the number of record you want to fetch. Default is 10.

operations.title: Execute Lucene Query
operations.description:
Executes a search query without using Elastic's DSL Query Syntax. An example query to search for the term "phishing" in documents where the status field is set to 200 would look like this:
phishing AND status:200

parameters.title: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.tooltip: An index is a logical namespace that maps to one or more primary shards and can have zero or more replica shards. Specify a particular index, based on which you want to run the query.

parameters.title: Size
parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: Set the number of results to return. Default is 10.

parameters.title: Run As User
parameters.name: run_as_user
parameters.tooltip: Run as user is kind of a delegation of account access to a different account or an admin account. For example, User X take on the role of User Y with the help of run as user mechanism

operations.title: Get Saved Search
operations.description: Retrieves details of saved searches from ElasticSearch/Kibana.

parameters.title: Object ID
parameters.name: object_id
parameters.tooltip: The Object ID of saved search.

parameters.title: Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.tooltip: The port of Kibana server from which need to retrieve the saved search.

operations.title: Get Alerts List
operations.description: Retrieves list of Alerts from ElasticSearch/Kibana.

parameters.title: Start Time
parameters.name: start
parameters.tooltip: Starting date time.

parameters.title: End Time
parameters.name: end
parameters.tooltip: Ending date time.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify query DSL that determines which results are returned from ElasticSearch.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: The maximum number of records to return.

parameters.title: Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.tooltip: The port of Kibana server from which need to retrieve the Alerts.

operations.title: Set Alert Status
operations.description: Sets the status of Alert in ElasticSearch/Kibana.

parameters.title: Status
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the alert status. For example: open, acknowledged or closed.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.name: signal_ids
parameters.tooltip: The Alert IDs whose status to be set.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify query DSL that determines which alerts are updated in ElasticSearch

parameters.title: Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.tooltip: The port of Kibana server from which need to set the status of the Alert.

operations.title: Apply Alert Tags
operations.description: Add and remove Alert tags in ElasticSearch/Kibana.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.name: ids
parameters.tooltip: The Alert IDs to which the tags to be set.

parameters.title: Tags to Add
parameters.name: tags_to_add
parameters.tooltip: Specify the alert tag to add. For example: False Positive.

parameters.title: Tags to Remove
parameters.name: tags_to_remove
parameters.tooltip: Specify the alert tag to remove. For example: Further Investigation Required.

parameters.title: Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.tooltip: The port of Kibana server from which need to apply tags to the Alert.

operations.title: Assign or Unassign Users from Alerts
operations.description: Assign or Unassign Users from Alert in ElasticSearch/Kibana.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.name: ids
parameters.tooltip: The Alert IDs to which the users to be assigned or unassigned.

parameters.title: Assign User
parameters.name: add
parameters.tooltip: Specify the user to assign to Alert.

parameters.title: Unassign User
parameters.name: remove
parameters.tooltip: Specify the user to unassign to Alert.

parameters.title: Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.tooltip: The port of Kibana server from which need to assign or unassign user from Alert.

operations.title: Fetch Incidents
operations.description: Executes query to fetch incidents from Elastisearch based on input parameters.

parameters.title: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.tooltip: Elasticsearch index or index pattern to search

parameters.title: Fetch Query
parameters.name: fetchQuery
parameters.tooltip: Params to filter query. Example:  kibana.alert.rule.tags : (“PROD” or “HIGH_Severity”)

parameters.title: Pull Time
parameters.name: pullTime
parameters.tooltip: Specify the last pull time to create time range

parameters.title: Fetch Size
parameters.name: fetchSize
parameters.tooltip: Number of incidents to fetch per run. Default is 50.

playbook_collections.description: Sample playbooks for "ElasticSearch" connector.
